status_definitions.implemented: Production-path behavior exists with tests and no synthetic success fallback.
status_definitions.experimental: Executable prototype exists, but security, validity, or operations evidence is incomplete.
status_definitions.adapter_required: The domain contract exists but requires an approved provider or AXIOM adapter.
status_definitions.specified: The behavior is designed but not yet implemented.
status_definitions.disabled: The capability must not be represented as available in governed or release builds.

capabilities.summary: Flutter and Riverpod curriculum overview and detail screens read a schema-verified bundled SQLite curriculum database and expose the bounded MTH1W verified-practice entry point.

The current secondary corpus deterministically produces 293 experimental records across 21 courses, but broader upstream official-document digests, licensing review, and course-by-course human verification remain incomplete; an official-source audit found known identifier conflicts in the preliminary MTH1W snapshot.

Ontario Elementary evidence infrastructure has 16/16 bounded metadata-only C1 source snapshots, 5 strict PDF and 11 observational HTML monitoring surfaces, deterministic human source-review and licensing-review targets, a reviewer dossier, and a fail-closed reference-only C2 intake gate. Human source approvals are 0/16, licensing decisions are 0/16, C2 eligibility is 0/16, and canonical C2 records remain 0.

Canonical curriculum packs bind jurisdiction, authority, namespace, source and licence status, ingestion digest, uncalibrated heuristics, record and course digests, deterministic manifests, and external-key Ed25519 signatures; activation and authority review remain unavailable.

A four-lesson Grade 9 Math Foundations Preview and all nine source-mapped MTH1W unit drafts provide goals, prerequisites, human-authored instruction, worked examples, at least two valid reasoning routes, multiple representations, metacognitive prompts, and offline practice without an AI tutor. All 43 planned primary lesson slots are authored and machine verified, but they account for 63.75 of the 110 planning hours; 46.25 hours plus educator/cultural review, licensing, reviewed course-wide coverage, cumulative assessment review, accessibility, governed progress, and educator workflows remain incomplete.

Four derived Grade 9 math topics have deterministic seed-based practice; the nine source-mapped unit drafts add 473 authored guided/independent/retrieval practice items, nine 10-item delayed-feedback quizzes with correction attempts, and nine educator-reviewable performance tasks. These are not grades or mastery records, and reviewed full-course and cumulative assessment remain unavailable.

A digest-pinned education contract, bounded relative-path Gateway transport, host-injected binding, and governed learner write/self-read runtime validate eight AXIOM intent types, exact consent purposes, idempotency, response traces, result fields, and fail-closed errors. No default host binding, local learner-record fallback, or production provider capsule is enabled.

A fail-closed compatibility profile pins AXIOM-MESH 0.12.0-dev.3, exact Education and learner-memory contracts, the semantic Gateway intents.submit seam, and the Gateway to Hypervisor to Sandbox to Grid authority path. The observed Mesh head and full Gateway digest are provenance rather than runtime equality gates, and a reviewed host must present compatible Education semantics before the governed runtime can bind.

Runtime Capsule, Personal Agent Pack, Compute Node Profile, Local Trust Envelope, and Agent Runtime Adapter surfaces are tracked for portable personal-compute continuity, but remain readiness inputs and grant no Axiom Education runtime authority.

Delegated human authority and delegated consent remain observed AXIOM-MESH draft/non-production inputs. They cannot be enabled until merged or otherwise stabilized upstream, repinned, independently reviewed, and represented by a new Education compatibility profile.

Assurance Graph and provider-observation foundations have merged into AXIOM-MESH but remain readiness-only for Axiom Education. Their Education adoption flags stay disabled, and graph or observation records are not treated as approval, policy, consent, or execution authority.

AXIOM Host remains a draft/non-production input while checkout-freshness foundations have merged upstream. Both remain non-authoritative for Education until an explicit reviewed adoption profile and executable evidence exist; the current runtime accepts only the reviewed relative Gateway requester and compatibility profile.

A provider-neutral governed Socratic execution seam now hard-filters learner, task, context, privacy, egress, retention, budget, and provider eligibility before one bounded inference call. The Claw fractions preview can consume instructional-only output through an explicitly injected binding, records minimized usage metadata, creates no mastery, grade, credit, or credential authority, performs no silent provider substitution, and falls back to a reviewed non-model explanation when execution is denied or unavailable. No model or provider is activated by default.
The incomplete Phi-3 path fails closed and cannot return simulated output; a versioned tokenizer, bounded decoder, model digest, evaluation evidence, and approved AXIOM provider remain required.

A local exact-rational verifier checks numeric answers and slope-intercept equations for the four MTH1W golden-path expectations, validates item digests, and fails closed on malformed input or missing verification; broader mathematics remains unimplemented.
Bounded image decoding and TFLite classification exist without mock equations, but no validated handwritten-math grammar, label map, or deterministic verifier is supplied.
Bounded stylus-signal preprocessing exists and fixed fallback scores were removed, but no validated scoring artifact is bundled or promoted.
The application-owned UDP/TCP mesh is disabled by default and only available as an explicitly keyed, bounded, AES-GCM development transport; it is not an identity or learner-record authority path.
Classroom synchronization will use admitted education nodes and AXIOM signed causal bundles rather than an application-owned authority path.
The current Hive student_data box is not an evidenced encrypted learner-record store and must not support governed learner data.

Executable governed learner event, memory-first commit, and self-read clients exist, but encrypted storage, revocation, selective export, appeal handling, and production provider operation remain AXIOM responsibilities requiring an approved adapter and host.
Legacy IRT-labelled values are exported only as visibly uncalibrated adaptation heuristics and are not psychometrically validated item-response parameters.
Learners will be able to export selected work, progress evidence, consent records, and provenance without unrelated private records.
Education credentials require the approved AXIOM SSI credential profile, issuer governance, revocation, and verification evidence.
Keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, text scaling, reduced-motion, stylus alternatives, and accessible export requirements are release gates.

non_claims: No current model binding provides a complete local tutor.
The governed Socratic execution seam does not activate a model or provider by default and cannot create mastery, grades, credits, credentials, or learner-record authority.

Ontario Elementary base source capture is complete for the current 16-source set, but human source review is 0/16 approved, licensing is 0/16 resolved, C2 intake eligibility is 0/16, and canonical C2 records remain 0; none of those later claims may be inferred from C1 capture.

The current four-lesson Grade 9 Math Foundations Preview and the nine source-mapped authored unit drafts are not a complete MTH1W course, credit, grade, transcript, Ministry-approved resource, school enrolment, or school-equivalency path.
The 110-hour MTH1W value is a planning envelope: authored primary lessons total 63.75 hours and leave 46.25 hours unallocated.

Known conflicts remain in preliminary local MTH1W identifiers; the official inventory, complete blueprint, and authored lesson slots do not authorize a complete-course claim without educator/cultural review, licensing, reviewed course-wide evidence, cumulative assessment review, accessibility alternatives, governed progress, and educator workflows.
The deterministic foundation practice engine covers only the locally labelled A1, A2, B2, and B4 topics and does not complete the ten-outcome vertical slice.
The current classroom mesh is not an AXIOM federation or secure production transport.
Local-first architecture alone does not establish legal or regulatory compliance.
Legacy difficulty and IRT-labelled values are uncalibrated heuristics, not validated psychometrics.
A valid pack signature proves integrity and signer possession, not Ministry approval, curriculum correctness, licensing permission, or safe activation.
The AXIOM education contract, compatibility profile, client, transport, and host binding do not enable a provider, learner-record store, or network authority by themselves.
Observed or merged AXIOM-MESH readiness surfaces do not become Axiom Education runtime capabilities without explicit reviewed adoption and compatible executable evidence.
Installing an education capsule does not grant access to learner data.
